items.question: Trong câu "The AWS Well-Architected Framework is a mental model that helps you build and operate systems on AWS.", cụm từ "mental model" nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The AWS Well-Architected Framework is a mental model that helps you build and operate systems on AWS.", what does the phrase "mental model" mean?
options: mô hình tư duy (cách suy nghĩ để giải quyết vấn đề)
optionsEn: a way of thinking used to understand problems
items.explanation: mental model /ˈmen.t̬əl ˈmɑː.dəl/ (cụm từ): mô hình tư duy. "A mental model" = khung suy nghĩ giúp bạn đánh giá và thiết kế hệ thống, không phải một dịch vụ.
items.explanationEn: mental model /ˈmen.t̬əl ˈmɑː.dəl/ (phrase): a way of thinking that helps you understand and decide. The framework is a thinking tool, not a service.

items.question: Trong câu "It helps you build systems on AWS in a way that is secure, reliable, efficient, and cost-optimized.", từ "reliable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It helps you build systems on AWS in a way that is secure, reliable, efficient, and cost-optimized.", what does "reliable" (adjective) mean?
options: đáng tin cậy, hoạt động ổn định
optionsEn: able to be trusted to work well
items.explanation: reliable /rɪˈlaɪ.ə.bəl/ (tính từ): đáng tin cậy. Hệ thống "reliable" hoạt động ổn định, ít sự cố. Danh từ: reliability (một trụ cột của Well-Architected).
items.explanationEn: reliable /rɪˈlaɪ.ə.bəl/ (adjective): able to be trusted to work consistently. Noun: reliability, which is one of the Well-Architected pillars.

items.question: Trong câu "It helps you build systems on AWS in a way that is secure, reliable, efficient, and cost-optimized.", từ "efficient" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It helps you build systems on AWS in a way that is secure, reliable, efficient, and cost-optimized.", what does "efficient" (adjective) mean?
options: hiệu quả, không lãng phí tài nguyên
items.explanation: efficient /ɪˈfɪʃ.ənt/ (tính từ): hiệu quả. "Efficient" = đạt kết quả tốt mà ít lãng phí. Danh từ: efficiency; trạng từ: efficiently.
items.explanationEn: efficient /ɪˈfɪʃ.ənt/ (adjective): working well without waste. Noun: efficiency; adverb: efficiently.

items.question: Trong câu "It is not a service, but a collection of design principles, review questions, and best practices.", từ "principles" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It is not a service, but a collection of design principles, review questions, and best practices.", what does "principles" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: principle /ˈprɪn.sə.pəl/ (danh từ): nguyên tắc. "Design principles" = các nguyên tắc thiết kế. Đừng nhầm với "principal" (hiệu trưởng, chính).
items.explanationEn: principle /ˈprɪn.sə.pəl/ (noun): a basic rule or belief that guides decisions. Do not confuse it with "principal" (head of a school, or main).

items.question: Trong câu "Nearly every scenario question revolves around choosing the optimal solution according to one of the pillars.", từ "pillar" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Nearly every scenario question revolves around choosing the optimal solution according to one of the pillars.", what does "pillar" (noun) mean?
options: trụ cột (phần nền tảng quan trọng)
optionsEn: a key supporting part of something
items.explanation: pillar /ˈpɪl.ɚ/ (danh từ): trụ cột. Well-Architected có 6 "pillars", mỗi trụ cột là một khía cạnh chính (bảo mật, độ tin cậy, chi phí...). Nghĩa gốc: cột trụ.
items.explanationEn: pillar /ˈpɪl.ɚ/ (noun): one of the main supporting parts. Well-Architected has 6 "pillars" such as security, reliability and cost. It literally means a column.

items.question: Trong câu "Nearly every scenario question revolves around choosing the optimal solution according to one of the pillars.", từ "optimal" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Nearly every scenario question revolves around choosing the optimal solution according to one of the pillars.", what does "optimal" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: optimal /ˈɑːp.tə.məl/ (tính từ): tối ưu. "The optimal solution" = giải pháp tốt nhất cho yêu cầu. Động từ: optimize.
items.explanationEn: optimal /ˈɑːp.tə.məl/ (adjective): best or most effective. "The optimal solution" is the best choice for the requirement. Verb: optimize.

items.question: Trong câu "Nearly every scenario question revolves around choosing the optimal solution according to one of the pillars.", cụm từ "according to" nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Nearly every scenario question revolves around choosing the optimal solution according to one of the pillars.", what does the phrase "according to" mean?
items.explanation: according to /əˈkɔːr.dɪŋ tuː/ (cụm từ): theo, dựa theo. "According to one of the pillars" = dựa trên tiêu chí của một trụ cột.
items.explanationEn: according to /əˈkɔːr.dɪŋ tuː/ (phrase): based on or as stated by. "According to one of the pillars" means judged by one pillar.

items.question: Trong câu "Therefore, understanding the 6 pillars is the skill that decides your score.", từ "therefore" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Therefore, understanding the 6 pillars is the skill that decides your score.", what does "therefore" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: therefore /ˈðer.fɔːr/ (trạng từ): vì vậy. "Therefore" nối kết quả với lý do phía trước. Đồng nghĩa: so, as a result.
items.explanationEn: therefore /ˈðer.fɔːr/ (adverb): for that reason, as a result. Synonyms: so, as a result.

items.question: Trong câu "Originally there were 5; in 2021 AWS added a 6th pillar, Sustainability.", từ "originally" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Originally there were 5; in 2021 AWS added a 6th pillar, Sustainability.", what does "originally" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: originally /əˈrɪdʒ.ən.əl.i/ (trạng từ): ban đầu. "Originally there were 5" = lúc đầu chỉ có 5 trụ cột. Tính từ: original.
items.explanationEn: originally /əˈrɪdʒ.ən.əl.i/ (adverb): at first. "Originally there were 5" means there were five in the beginning. Adjective: original.

items.question: Trong câu "Operational Excellence: run and monitor systems, infrastructure as code, small reversible changes, learn from failure.", từ "reversible" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Operational Excellence: run and monitor systems, infrastructure as code, small reversible changes, learn from failure.", what does "reversible" (adjective) mean?
options: có thể đảo ngược, hoàn tác được
items.explanation: reversible /rɪˈvɝː.sə.bəl/ (tính từ): đảo ngược được. "Small reversible changes" = thay đổi nhỏ, dễ hoàn tác nếu có lỗi. Trái nghĩa: irreversible.
items.explanationEn: reversible /rɪˈvɝː.sə.bəl/ (adjective): able to be undone. "Small reversible changes" are easy to roll back if something goes wrong. Opposite: irreversible.

items.question: Trong câu "Security: protect data and systems, least privilege, strong identity foundation, encryption, traceability.", cụm từ "least privilege" nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Security: protect data and systems, least privilege, strong identity foundation, encryption, traceability.", what does the phrase "least privilege" mean?
options: quyền tối thiểu (chỉ cấp đúng quyền cần thiết)
optionsEn: granting only the permissions that are needed
items.explanation: least privilege /liːst ˈprɪv.əl.ɪdʒ/ (cụm từ): quyền tối thiểu. Nguyên tắc "least privilege" = chỉ cấp đúng những quyền cần để làm việc, không hơn.
items.explanationEn: least privilege /liːst ˈprɪv.əl.ɪdʒ/ (phrase): the rule of giving only the permissions needed to do a job, nothing more.

items.question: Trong câu "Security: protect data and systems, least privilege, strong identity foundation, encryption, traceability.", từ "traceability" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Security: protect data and systems, least privilege, strong identity foundation, encryption, traceability.", what does "traceability" (noun) mean?
options: khả năng truy vết (biết ai đã làm gì, khi nào)
optionsEn: the ability to track who did what and when
items.explanation: traceability /ˌtreɪ.səˈbɪl.ə.t̬i/ (danh từ): khả năng truy vết. "Traceability" = ghi log, theo dõi để biết ai thay đổi gì (CloudTrail, Config). Động từ: trace.
items.explanationEn: traceability /ˌtreɪ.səˈbɪl.ə.t̬i/ (noun): the ability to track who did what and when, using tools like CloudTrail. Verb: trace.

items.question: Trong câu "Reliability: recover from failure, scale horizontally, auto-recovery, test recovery.", từ "horizontally" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Reliability: recover from failure, scale horizontally, auto-recovery, test recovery.", what does "horizontally" (adverb) mean?
options: theo chiều dọc (nâng cấp một máy)
items.explanation: horizontally /ˌhɔːr.əˈzɑːn.t̬əl.i/ (trạng từ): theo chiều ngang. "Scale horizontally" = thêm nhiều instance; "scale vertically" = tăng cấu hình một instance.
items.explanationEn: horizontally /ˌhɔːr.əˈzɑːn.t̬əl.i/ (adverb): sideways. "Scale horizontally" means add more instances, while "scale vertically" means make one instance bigger.

items.question: Trong câu "Cost Optimization: avoid unneeded cost, choose the right pricing model, use managed services.", từ "unneeded" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Cost Optimization: avoid unneeded cost, choose the right pricing model, use managed services.", what does "unneeded" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: unneeded /ʌnˈniː.dɪd/ (tính từ): không cần thiết. "Avoid unneeded cost" = tránh chi phí thừa. Tiền tố "un-" = không.
items.explanationEn: unneeded /ʌnˈniː.dɪd/ (adjective): not necessary. "Avoid unneeded cost" means do not pay for what you do not need. The prefix "un-" means not.

items.question: Trong câu "Cost Optimization: avoid unneeded cost, choose the right pricing model, use managed services, elasticity.", từ "elasticity" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Cost Optimization: avoid unneeded cost, choose the right pricing model, use managed services, elasticity.", what does "elasticity" (noun) mean?
options: tính co giãn (tự tăng/giảm tài nguyên theo nhu cầu)
optionsEn: the ability to grow or shrink with demand
items.explanation: elasticity /ˌiː.læsˈtɪs.ə.t̬i/ (danh từ): tính co giãn. "Elasticity" = tài nguyên tự tăng khi tải cao và giảm khi tải thấp, giúp tiết kiệm chi phí. Tính từ: elastic.
items.explanationEn: elasticity /ˌiː.læsˈtɪs.ə.t̬i/ (noun): the ability to grow or shrink resources with demand, which saves money. Adjective: elastic.

items.question: Trong câu "Sustainability: minimize environmental impact, maximize resource utilization.", từ "environmental" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Sustainability: minimize environmental impact, maximize resource utilization.", what does "environmental" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: environmental /ɪnˌvaɪ.rənˈmen.t̬əl/ (tính từ): thuộc môi trường. "Environmental impact" = tác động đến môi trường (năng lượng, khí thải). Danh từ: environment.
items.explanationEn: environmental /ɪnˌvaɪ.rənˈmen.t̬əl/ (adjective): relating to the natural world. "Environmental impact" is the effect on nature, such as energy use. Noun: environment.

items.question: Trong câu "Sustainability: minimize environmental impact, maximize resource utilization.", từ "impact" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Sustainability: minimize environmental impact, maximize resource utilization.", what does "impact" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: impact /ˈɪm.pækt/ (danh từ): tác động. "Minimize environmental impact" = giảm tác động xấu đến môi trường.
items.explanationEn: impact /ˈɪm.pækt/ (noun): an effect or influence. "Minimize environmental impact" means reduce harm to the environment.

items.question: Trong câu "Sustainability: minimize environmental impact, maximize resource utilization.", từ "maximize" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Sustainability: minimize environmental impact, maximize resource utilization.", what does "maximize" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to make as small as possible
to make as large as possible
items.explanation: maximize /ˈmæk.sə.maɪz/ (động từ): tối đa hóa. "Maximize resource utilization" = dùng tài nguyên hết mức, không để lãng phí. Trái nghĩa: minimize.
items.explanationEn: maximize /ˈmæk.sə.maɪz/ (verb): to make as large as possible. "Maximize resource utilization" means use resources fully. Opposite: minimize.

items.question: Trong câu "Sustainability: minimize environmental impact, maximize resource utilization.", từ "utilization" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Sustainability: minimize environmental impact, maximize resource utilization.", what does "utilization" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: utilization /ˌjuː.t̬əl.əˈzeɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): mức sử dụng. "Resource utilization" = tài nguyên được dùng bao nhiêu phần trăm. Động từ: utilize.
items.explanationEn: utilization /ˌjuː.t̬əl.əˈzeɪ.ʃən/ (noun): how much of something is being used. "Resource utilization" is the share of resources in use. Verb: utilize.

items.question: Trong câu "Quick mnemonic for the six pillars.", từ "mnemonic" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Quick mnemonic for the six pillars.", what does "mnemonic" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a trick to help you remember
items.explanation: mnemonic /nɪˈmɑː.nɪk/ (danh từ): mẹo ghi nhớ. "Mnemonic" là câu/chữ viết tắt giúp nhớ nhanh. Chữ "m" đầu không phát âm.
items.explanationEn: mnemonic /nɪˈmɑː.nɪk/ (noun): a trick, such as a phrase or acronym, that helps you remember. The first "m" is silent.

items.question: Trong câu "Each scenario question usually leans toward exactly one pillar — find that pillar before comparing the answers.", cụm từ "leans toward" nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Each scenario question usually leans toward exactly one pillar — find that pillar before comparing the answers.", what does the phrase "leans toward" mean?
items.explanation: lean toward /liːn təˈwɔːrd/ (cụm từ): nghiêng về. "Leans toward one pillar" = câu hỏi thiên về một trụ cột cụ thể.
items.explanationEn: lean toward /liːn təˈwɔːrd/ (phrase): to tend towards or favor. "Leans toward one pillar" means the question mainly concerns that pillar.

items.question: Trong câu "Stop guessing capacity: use Auto Scaling to provision to real demand instead of over-buying.", từ "guessing" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Stop guessing capacity: use Auto Scaling to provision to real demand instead of over-buying.", what does "guessing" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: guess /ɡes/ (động từ): đoán. "Stop guessing capacity" = đừng phỏng đoán dung lượng cần dùng, hãy để hệ thống tự co giãn.
items.explanationEn: guess /ɡes/ (verb): to estimate without being sure. "Stop guessing capacity" means let the system scale instead of estimating.

items.question: Trong câu "Stop guessing capacity: use Auto Scaling to provision to real demand instead of over-buying.", từ "provision" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Stop guessing capacity: use Auto Scaling to provision to real demand instead of over-buying.", what does "provision" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to supply or set up resources
items.explanation: provision /prəˈvɪʒ.ən/ (động từ): cấp phát. "Provision to real demand" = cấp tài nguyên đúng theo nhu cầu thực tế. Danh từ: provisioning.
items.explanationEn: provision /prəˈvɪʒ.ən/ (verb): to supply or set up resources. "Provision to real demand" means create just the resources actually needed. Noun: provisioning.

items.question: Trong câu "Stop guessing capacity: use Auto Scaling to provision to real demand instead of over-buying.", từ "demand" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Stop guessing capacity: use Auto Scaling to provision to real demand instead of over-buying.", what does "demand" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: demand /dɪˈmænd/ (danh từ): nhu cầu. "Real demand" = lượng tài nguyên thực sự cần. Cụm liên quan: on-demand (theo nhu cầu).
items.explanationEn: demand /dɪˈmænd/ (noun): the amount of something that is needed. "Real demand" is what is actually required. Related: on-demand.

items.question: Trong câu "Test at production scale: create a realistic test environment then tear it down when finished.", từ "realistic" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Test at production scale: create a realistic test environment then tear it down when finished.", what does "realistic" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: realistic /ˌriː.əˈlɪs.tɪk/ (tính từ): sát thực tế. "Realistic test environment" = môi trường thử nghiệm giống môi trường thật. Trái nghĩa: unrealistic.
items.explanationEn: realistic /ˌriː.əˈlɪs.tɪk/ (adjective): close to real life. A "realistic test environment" looks like the real one. Opposite: unrealistic.

items.question: Trong câu "Test at production scale: create a realistic test environment then tear it down when finished.", cụm từ "tear it down" nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Test at production scale: create a realistic test environment then tear it down when finished.", what does the phrase "tear it down" mean?
items.explanation: tear down /ter daʊn/ (cụm từ): gỡ bỏ. "Tear it down" = xóa toàn bộ môi trường thử nghiệm sau khi dùng xong để không tốn tiền. Trái nghĩa: spin up/set up.
items.explanationEn: tear down /ter daʊn/ (phrase): to remove completely. "Tear it down" means delete the test environment when done to save money. Opposite: set up.

items.question: Trong câu "Automate with infrastructure as code so changes are easy to reproduce, control, and reverse.", từ "reproduce" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Automate with infrastructure as code so changes are easy to reproduce, control, and reverse.", what does "reproduce" (verb) mean?
options: tái tạo, làm lại y hệt
optionsEn: to make again in exactly the same way
items.explanation: reproduce /ˌriː.prəˈduːs/ (động từ): tái tạo. "Easy to reproduce" = dễ tạo lại đúng như cũ. Cũng dùng khi "reproduce a bug" (tái hiện lỗi).
items.explanationEn: reproduce /ˌriː.prəˈduːs/ (verb): to create again in the same way. Also used in "reproduce a bug" (make a bug happen again).

items.question: Trong câu "Automate with infrastructure as code so changes are easy to reproduce, control, and reverse.", từ "reverse" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Automate with infrastructure as code so changes are easy to reproduce, control, and reverse.", what does "reverse" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: reverse /rɪˈvɝːs/ (động từ): đảo ngược. "Easy to reverse" = dễ hoàn tác thay đổi. Tính từ: reversible.
items.explanationEn: reverse /rɪˈvɝːs/ (verb): to undo or change back. "Easy to reverse" means changes can be rolled back. Adjective: reversible.

items.question: Trong câu "Allow evolutionary architectures.", từ "evolutionary" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Allow evolutionary architectures.", what does "evolutionary" (adjective) mean?
options: cách mạng, thay đổi đột ngột
tiến hóa, thay đổi dần theo thời gian
items.explanation: evolutionary /ˌev.əˈluː.ʃən.er.i/ (tính từ): tiến hóa. "Evolutionary architectures" = kiến trúc có thể cải tiến dần theo nhu cầu. Danh từ: evolution.
items.explanationEn: evolutionary /ˌev.əˈluː.ʃən.er.i/ (adjective): developing gradually over time. "Evolutionary architectures" can improve step by step. Noun: evolution.

items.question: Trong câu "Drive decisions with data: use metrics from CloudWatch and X-Ray to decide instead of intuition.", từ "intuition" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Drive decisions with data: use metrics from CloudWatch and X-Ray to decide instead of intuition.", what does "intuition" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: intuition /ˌɪn.tuˈɪʃ.ən/ (danh từ): trực giác. "Instead of intuition" = dựa vào số liệu thay vì cảm tính. Tính từ: intuitive (trực quan).
items.explanationEn: intuition /ˌɪn.tuˈɪʃ.ən/ (noun): knowing something by feeling rather than facts. "Instead of intuition" means rely on data, not gut feeling. Adjective: intuitive.

items.question: Trong câu "Improve through game days: proactively simulate failures to test recovery.", từ "proactively" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Improve through game days: proactively simulate failures to test recovery.", what does "proactively" (adverb) mean?
options: chủ động (làm trước khi có vấn đề)
optionsEn: acting in advance before problems happen
items.explanation: proactively /proʊˈæk.tɪv.li/ (trạng từ): chủ động. "Proactively simulate failures" = chủ động giả lập sự cố trước khi nó thật sự xảy ra. Trái nghĩa: reactively.
items.explanationEn: proactively /proʊˈæk.tɪv.li/ (adverb): acting early to prevent problems. "Proactively simulate failures" means test failures before real ones happen. Opposite: reactively.

items.question: Trong câu "Improve through game days: proactively simulate failures to test recovery.", từ "simulate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Improve through game days: proactively simulate failures to test recovery.", what does "simulate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: simulate /ˈsɪm.jə.leɪt/ (động từ): mô phỏng. "Simulate failures" = giả lập sự cố để kiểm tra khả năng phục hồi. Danh từ: simulation.
items.explanationEn: simulate /ˈsɪm.jə.leɪt/ (verb): to imitate a real situation for testing. "Simulate failures" means create fake failures. Noun: simulation.

items.question: Trong câu "Proactively simulate failures to test recovery (in the spirit of chaos engineering).", cụm từ "in the spirit of" nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Proactively simulate failures to test recovery (in the spirit of chaos engineering).", what does the phrase "in the spirit of" mean?
options: theo tinh thần của, theo cách nghĩ của
items.explanation: in the spirit of /ɪn ðə ˈspɪr.ɪt əv/ (cụm từ): theo tinh thần của. "In the spirit of chaos engineering" = làm theo ý tưởng của chaos engineering.
items.explanationEn: in the spirit of /ɪn ðə ˈspɪr.ɪt əv/ (phrase): following the main idea of something. "In the spirit of chaos engineering" means following its approach.

items.question: Trong câu "Proactively simulate failures to test recovery (in the spirit of chaos engineering).", cụm từ "chaos engineering" nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Proactively simulate failures to test recovery (in the spirit of chaos engineering).", what does the phrase "chaos engineering" mean?
options: thiết kế giao diện ngẫu nhiên
quản lý dự án lộn xộn
kỹ thuật cố tình gây lỗi để kiểm tra độ bền hệ thống
kỹ thuật mã hóa dữ liệu
optionsEn: deliberately causing failures to test resilience
items.explanation: chaos engineering /ˈkeɪ.ɑːs ˌen.dʒɪˈnɪr.ɪŋ/ (cụm từ): chaos engineering: cố ý gây sự cố (tắt máy, ngắt mạng) trong môi trường thật hoặc gần thật để kiểm tra hệ thống có chịu được không. Chaos /ˈkeɪ.ɑːs/ = hỗn loạn.
items.explanationEn: chaos engineering /ˈkeɪ.ɑːs ˌen.dʒɪˈnɪr.ɪŋ/ (phrase): deliberately breaking things, such as stopping servers, to check that the system survives. "Chaos" means complete disorder.

items.question: Trong câu "This is a tool to self-assess your architecture, not to monitor operations.", từ "self-assess" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is a tool to self-assess your architecture, not to monitor operations.", what does "self-assess" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: self-assess /ˌself əˈses/ (động từ): tự đánh giá. Well-Architected Tool giúp bạn "self-assess" kiến trúc bằng cách trả lời bộ câu hỏi. Danh từ: self-assessment.
items.explanationEn: self-assess /ˌself əˈses/ (verb): to judge your own work. The Well-Architected Tool lets you "self-assess" by answering questions. Noun: self-assessment.

items.question: Trong câu "The result is a list of risks (high/medium risk) with improvement recommendations.", từ "improvement" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The result is a list of risks (high/medium risk) with improvement recommendations.", what does "improvement" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: improvement /ɪmˈpruːv.mənt/ (danh từ): sự cải thiện. "Improvement recommendations" = các đề xuất để làm kiến trúc tốt hơn. Động từ: improve.
items.explanationEn: improvement /ɪmˈpruːv.mənt/ (noun): the act of making something better. "Improvement recommendations" suggest how to improve. Verb: improve.

items.question: Trong câu "Trusted Advisor provides recommendations across 5 check categories.", từ "categories" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Trusted Advisor provides recommendations across 5 check categories.", what does "categories" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: category /ˈkæt̬.ə.ɡɔːr.i/ (danh từ): hạng mục. "5 check categories" = 5 nhóm kiểm tra (Cost, Security, Fault Tolerance, Performance, Service Limits).
items.explanationEn: category /ˈkæt̬.ə.ɡɔːr.i/ (noun): a group of things of the same type. The "5 check categories" are Cost, Security, Fault Tolerance, Performance and Service Limits.

items.question: Trong câu "Cost Optimization — detects idle resources, suggests Reserved Instances.", từ "idle" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Cost Optimization — detects idle resources, suggests Reserved Instances.", what does "idle" (adjective) mean?
options: nhàn rỗi, không được sử dụng
items.explanation: idle /ˈaɪ.dəl/ (tính từ): nhàn rỗi. "Idle resources" = tài nguyên đang chạy nhưng không dùng tới, gây lãng phí tiền.
items.explanationEn: idle /ˈaɪ.dəl/ (adjective): not active or in use. "Idle resources" run but do nothing, which wastes money.

items.question: Trong câu "Cost Optimization — detects idle resources, suggests Reserved Instances.", từ "suggests" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Cost Optimization — detects idle resources, suggests Reserved Instances.", what does "suggests" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: suggest /səɡˈdʒest/ (động từ): đề xuất. "Suggests Reserved Instances" = gợi ý mua Reserved Instances để tiết kiệm. Danh từ: suggestion.
items.explanationEn: suggest /səɡˈdʒest/ (verb): to put forward an idea. "Suggests Reserved Instances" means recommends buying them to save money. Noun: suggestion.

items.question: Trong câu "Security — warns about wide-open security groups, MFA on root, exposed access keys.", từ "warns" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Security — warns about wide-open security groups, MFA on root, exposed access keys.", what does "warns" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to tell about a possible danger
items.explanation: warn /wɔːrn/ (động từ): cảnh báo. "Warns about wide-open security groups" = cảnh báo khi security group mở quá rộng. Danh từ: warning.
items.explanationEn: warn /wɔːrn/ (verb): to tell someone about a danger. Noun: warning.

items.question: Trong câu "Security — warns about wide-open security groups, MFA on root, exposed access keys.", từ "wide-open" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Security — warns about wide-open security groups, MFA on root, exposed access keys.", what does "wide-open" (adjective) mean?
options: mở toang, cho phép truy cập quá rộng
optionsEn: fully open, allowing too much access
items.explanation: wide-open /ˌwaɪd ˈoʊ.pən/ (tính từ): mở toang. "Wide-open security groups" = security group cho phép mọi IP (0.0.0.0/0) truy cập, rất nguy hiểm.
items.explanationEn: wide-open /ˌwaɪd ˈoʊ.pən/ (adjective): completely open. "Wide-open security groups" allow access from anywhere (0.0.0.0/0), which is risky.

items.question: Trong câu "Security — warns about wide-open security groups, MFA on root, exposed access keys.", từ "exposed" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Security — warns about wide-open security groups, MFA on root, exposed access keys.", what does "exposed" (adjective) mean?
options: bị lộ, bị công khai ra ngoài
optionsEn: made visible to others, not protected
items.explanation: exposed /ɪkˈspoʊzd/ (tính từ): bị lộ. "Exposed access keys" = khóa truy cập bị lộ (ví dụ đẩy lên GitHub công khai). Động từ: expose.
items.explanationEn: exposed /ɪkˈspoʊzd/ (adjective): left visible and unprotected. "Exposed access keys" have leaked, for example to a public GitHub repo. Verb: expose.

items.question: Trong câu "Fault Tolerance — checks Multi-AZ, backups, redundancy configuration.", từ "redundancy" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Fault Tolerance — checks Multi-AZ, backups, redundancy configuration.", what does "redundancy" (noun) mean?
options: dự phòng (có thêm bản sao/thành phần để thay thế khi hỏng)
optionsEn: extra components kept to take over on failure
items.explanation: redundancy /rɪˈdʌn.dən.si/ (danh từ): dự phòng. Trong kiến trúc, "redundancy" là có thêm thành phần/bản sao để hệ thống vẫn chạy khi một phần hỏng. Tính từ: redundant.
items.explanationEn: redundancy /rɪˈdʌn.dən.si/ (noun): having extra parts or copies so the system keeps running if one fails. Adjective: redundant.

items.question: Trong câu "Service Limits — warns when you are approaching a service quota.", từ "approaching" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Service Limits — warns when you are approaching a service quota.", what does "approaching" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: approach /əˈproʊtʃ/ (động từ): tiến gần. "Approaching a service quota" = sắp chạm hạn mức dịch vụ. Danh từ "approach" = cách tiếp cận.
items.explanationEn: approach /əˈproʊtʃ/ (verb): to come near. "Approaching a service quota" means almost reaching the limit. The noun "approach" means a method.

items.question: Trong câu "Service Limits — warns when you are approaching a service quota.", từ "quota" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Service Limits — warns when you are approaching a service quota.", what does "quota" (noun) mean?
options: hạn mức (giới hạn tối đa được phép dùng)
optionsEn: a maximum amount you are allowed to use
items.explanation: quota /ˈkwoʊ.t̬ə/ (danh từ): hạn mức. "Service quota" = số lượng tài nguyên tối đa một tài khoản được dùng (ví dụ số EC2 instance).
items.explanationEn: quota /ˈkwoʊ.t̬ə/ (noun): the maximum amount allowed. A "service quota" limits how many resources an account can use.

items.question: Trong câu "Basic/Developer accounts only see a subset of the checks.", từ "subset" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Basic/Developer accounts only see a subset of the checks.", what does "subset" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a smaller part of a larger group
items.explanation: subset /ˈsʌb.set/ (danh từ): tập con. "A subset of the checks" = chỉ một phần các mục kiểm tra. Tiền tố "sub-" = nhỏ hơn, bên dưới.
items.explanationEn: subset /ˈsʌb.set/ (noun): a smaller group taken from a larger one. The prefix "sub-" means under or smaller.

items.question: Trong câu "Cost Explorer: visualize and analyze cost/usage over time and forecast future spend.", từ "forecast" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Cost Explorer: visualize and analyze cost/usage over time and forecast future spend.", what does "forecast" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: forecast /ˈfɔːr.kæst/ (động từ): dự báo. "Forecast future spend" = ước tính chi phí trong tương lai. Cũng là danh từ: weather forecast (dự báo thời tiết).
items.explanationEn: forecast /ˈfɔːr.kæst/ (verb): to predict what will happen. "Forecast future spend" means estimate future costs. Also a noun: weather forecast.

items.question: Trong câu "AWS Budgets: send alerts when cost (or usage) exceeds, or is forecast to exceed, a threshold.", từ "threshold" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "AWS Budgets: send alerts when cost (or usage) exceeds, or is forecast to exceed, a threshold.", what does "threshold" (noun) mean?
options: ngưỡng (mức giới hạn kích hoạt cảnh báo)
optionsEn: a limit that triggers an action when crossed
items.explanation: threshold /ˈθreʃ.hoʊld/ (danh từ): ngưỡng. "Exceeds a threshold" = vượt quá mức đã đặt, khi đó sẽ gửi cảnh báo. Nghĩa gốc: ngưỡng cửa.
items.explanationEn: threshold /ˈθreʃ.hoʊld/ (noun): a level that, when crossed, triggers an action. It literally means the bottom of a doorway.

items.question: Trong câu "AWS Budgets: send alerts when cost (or usage) exceeds, or is forecast to exceed, a threshold.", từ "exceeds" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "AWS Budgets: send alerts when cost (or usage) exceeds, or is forecast to exceed, a threshold.", what does "exceeds" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: exceed /ɪkˈsiːd/ (động từ): vượt quá. "Cost exceeds a threshold" = chi phí vượt ngưỡng. Danh từ: excess.
items.explanationEn: exceed /ɪkˈsiːd/ (verb): to be more than a limit. "Cost exceeds a threshold" means it goes above the set level. Noun: excess.

items.question: Trong câu "Step 1 — Read the QUALIFIER in the question carefully.", từ "carefully" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Step 1 — Read the QUALIFIER in the question carefully.", what does "carefully" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: carefully /ˈker.fəl.i/ (trạng từ): cẩn thận. "Read carefully" = đọc kỹ từng chữ. Tính từ: careful.
items.explanationEn: carefully /ˈker.fəl.i/ (adverb): with close attention. "Read carefully" means read every word with attention. Adjective: careful.

items.question: Trong câu "AWS always plants a decisive keyword in the prompt.", từ "plants" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "AWS always plants a decisive keyword in the prompt.", what does "plants" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to put something in place on purpose
items.explanation: plant /plænt/ (động từ): cài, gài vào. "Plants a decisive keyword" = cố ý đặt một từ khóa quyết định vào đề. Nghĩa gốc: trồng (cây).
items.explanationEn: plant /plænt/ (verb): to put something somewhere deliberately. "Plants a decisive keyword" means places it in the question on purpose. It also means to grow plants.

items.question: Trong câu "AWS always plants a decisive keyword in the prompt.", từ "decisive" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "AWS always plants a decisive keyword in the prompt.", what does "decisive" (adjective) mean?
optionsEn: settling the result, deciding the answer
items.explanation: decisive /dɪˈsaɪ.sɪv/ (tính từ): mang tính quyết định. "A decisive keyword" = từ khóa quyết định đáp án đúng. Động từ: decide.
items.explanationEn: decisive /dɪˈsaɪ.sɪv/ (adjective): able to settle the outcome. "A decisive keyword" is the word that decides the right answer. Verb: decide.

items.question: Trong câu "The qualifier tells you which pillar is being prioritized.", từ "prioritized" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The qualifier tells you which pillar is being prioritized.", what does "prioritized" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: prioritize /praɪˈɔːr.ə.taɪz/ (động từ): ưu tiên. "Which pillar is being prioritized" = trụ cột nào đang được đặt lên hàng đầu. Danh từ: priority.
items.explanationEn: prioritize /praɪˈɔːr.ə.taɪz/ (verb): to treat something as most important. Noun: priority.

items.question: Trong câu "Step 1 — Read the QUALIFIER in the question carefully.", từ "qualifier" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Step 1 — Read the QUALIFIER in the question carefully.", what does "qualifier" (noun) mean?
options: từ chỉ tiêu chí (như MOST, LEAST) giới hạn yêu cầu
optionsEn: a word like MOST or LEAST that narrows the requirement
items.explanation: qualifier /ˈkwɑː.lə.faɪ.ɚ/ (danh từ): từ hạn định. "Qualifier" trong đề là cụm như "MOST cost-effective", "LEAST operational overhead" chỉ ra tiêu chí chọn đáp án.
items.explanationEn: qualifier /ˈkwɑː.lə.faɪ.ɚ/ (noun): a word or phrase that limits the meaning, such as "MOST cost-effective" or "LEAST operational overhead".

items.question: Trong câu "MOST highly available / resilient → Reliability: Multi-AZ, ELB + ASG, Route 53 failover.", từ "resilient" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "MOST highly available / resilient → Reliability: Multi-AZ, ELB + ASG, Route 53 failover.", what does "resilient" (adjective) mean?
options: có khả năng phục hồi, chống chịu tốt
optionsEn: able to recover quickly from problems
items.explanation: resilient /rɪˈzɪl.jənt/ (tính từ): có khả năng phục hồi. Hệ thống "resilient" chịu được sự cố và nhanh chóng hoạt động lại. Danh từ: resilience.
items.explanationEn: resilient /rɪˈzɪl.jənt/ (adjective): able to withstand and recover from problems. Noun: resilience.

items.question: Trong câu "LEAST operational overhead / fully managed → Operational Excellence: choose managed/serverless.", từ "overhead" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "LEAST operational overhead / fully managed → Operational Excellence: choose managed/serverless.", what does "overhead" (noun) mean?
options: gánh nặng/công sức vận hành phát sinh
optionsEn: extra work or cost needed to run something
items.explanation: overhead /ˈoʊ.vɚ.hed/ (danh từ): chi phí/công sức phụ. "Operational overhead" = khối lượng việc vận hành, bảo trì phải tự làm. Dịch vụ managed giúp giảm overhead.
items.explanationEn: overhead /ˈoʊ.vɚ.hed/ (noun): extra work or cost needed to keep something running. Managed services reduce "operational overhead".

items.question: Trong câu "Step 2 — Eliminate wrong answers and spot the 'distractor'.", từ "distractor" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Step 2 — Eliminate wrong answers and spot the 'distractor'.", what does "distractor" (noun) mean?
options: phương án gây nhiễu (đáp án sai trông có vẻ đúng)
optionsEn: a wrong option that looks right
items.explanation: distractor /dɪˈstræk.tɚ/ (danh từ): phương án gây nhiễu. "Distractor" là đáp án sai được viết cho có vẻ hợp lý để đánh lừa. Động từ: distract (làm xao nhãng).
items.explanationEn: distractor /dɪˈstræk.tɚ/ (noun): a wrong answer designed to look correct. Verb: distract.

items.question: Trong câu "Step 2 — Eliminate wrong answers and spot the 'distractor'.", từ "spot" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Step 2 — Eliminate wrong answers and spot the 'distractor'.", what does "spot" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: spot /spɑːt/ (động từ): phát hiện. "Spot the distractor" = nhận ra đáp án gây nhiễu. Lưu ý: "Spot Instance" là loại EC2 giá rẻ, nghĩa khác.
items.explanationEn: spot /spɑːt/ (verb): to notice or find. "Spot the distractor" means notice the trick option. "Spot Instance" is a different meaning (cheap spare EC2 capacity).

items.question: Trong câu "Deprecated technology: Classic Load Balancer (CLB) instead of ALB/NLB.", từ "deprecated" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Deprecated technology: Classic Load Balancer (CLB) instead of ALB/NLB.", what does "deprecated" (adjective) mean?
options: không còn được khuyến nghị, sắp bị loại bỏ
optionsEn: no longer recommended and being phased out
items.explanation: deprecated /ˈdep.rə.keɪ.t̬ɪd/ (tính từ): không còn khuyến nghị. Công nghệ "deprecated" vẫn chạy nhưng nhà cung cấp khuyên không dùng nữa (như CLB).
items.explanationEn: deprecated /ˈdep.rə.keɪ.t̬ɪd/ (adjective): still available but no longer recommended, like the Classic Load Balancer.

items.question: Trong câu "Self-managed EC2 when serverless fits better.", từ "fits" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Self-managed EC2 when serverless fits better.", what does "fits" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: fit /fɪt/ (động từ): phù hợp. "Serverless fits better" = serverless phù hợp hơn với yêu cầu. Tính từ "fit" = vừa vặn, khỏe mạnh.
items.explanationEn: fit /fɪt/ (verb): to be suitable. "Serverless fits better" means it matches the need better. The adjective "fit" means healthy or right-sized.

items.question: Trong câu "'Detect threats / anomalous behavior' → GuardDuty.", từ "threats" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "'Detect threats / anomalous behavior' → GuardDuty.", what does "threats" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: threat /θret/ (danh từ): mối đe dọa. "Detect threats" = phát hiện nguy cơ tấn công. Động từ: threaten.
items.explanationEn: threat /θret/ (noun): something that may cause harm. "Detect threats" means find possible attacks. Verb: threaten.

items.question: Trong câu "'Detect threats / anomalous behavior' → GuardDuty.", từ "anomalous" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "'Detect threats / anomalous behavior' → GuardDuty.", what does "anomalous" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: anomalous /əˈnɑː.mə.ləs/ (tính từ): bất thường. "Anomalous behavior" = hành vi khác thường (ví dụ đăng nhập từ nước lạ). Danh từ: anomaly.
items.explanationEn: anomalous /əˈnɑː.mə.ləs/ (adjective): different from what is normal. "Anomalous behavior" might be a login from an unusual country. Noun: anomaly.

items.question: Trong câu "Design a 3-tier web application that is highly available and cost-optimized, serving global users.", từ "3-tier" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Design a 3-tier web application that is highly available and cost-optimized, serving global users.", what does "3-tier" (noun) mean?
options: tầng (lớp trong kiến trúc ứng dụng)
optionsEn: a layer in an application architecture
items.explanation: tier /tɪr/ (danh từ): tầng. "3-tier application" = ứng dụng 3 tầng: giao diện (web), xử lý (app) và dữ liệu (database). Phát âm giống "tear" (nước mắt).
items.explanationEn: tier /tɪr/ (noun): a layer. A "3-tier application" has web, application and database layers. It sounds like "tear" (from crying).

items.question: Trong câu "Design a 3-tier web application that is highly available and cost-optimized, serving global users.", từ "serving" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Design a 3-tier web application that is highly available and cost-optimized, serving global users.", what does "serving" (verb) mean?
options: phục vụ, cung cấp dịch vụ cho
items.explanation: serve /sɝːv/ (động từ): phục vụ. "Serving global users" = phục vụ người dùng trên toàn cầu. Danh từ: server (máy chủ).
items.explanationEn: serve /sɝːv/ (verb): to provide something to users. "Serving global users" means handling users around the world. Noun: server.

items.question: Trong câu "Route 53 — DNS, routing and health-based failover (Reliability).", từ "failover" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Route 53 — DNS, routing and health-based failover (Reliability).", what does "failover" (noun) mean?
options: chuyển đổi dự phòng (tự chuyển sang hệ thống khác khi hỏng)
optionsEn: switching to a backup system on failure
items.explanation: failover /ˈfeɪlˌoʊ.vɚ/ (danh từ): chuyển đổi dự phòng. "Health-based failover" = khi máy chính không khỏe, tự chuyển lưu lượng sang máy dự phòng.
items.explanationEn: failover /ˈfeɪlˌoʊ.vɚ/ (noun): automatically switching to a standby system when the main one fails.

items.question: Trong câu "CloudFront — CDN caching static content at the edge, reducing global latency and offloading the origin.", từ "origin" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "CloudFront — CDN caching static content at the edge, reducing global latency and offloading the origin.", what does "origin" (noun) mean?
options: máy chủ gốc (nơi lưu nội dung gốc)
optionsEn: the source server holding the original content
items.explanation: origin /ˈɔːr.ə.dʒɪn/ (danh từ): máy chủ gốc. Với CloudFront, "origin" là S3/ALB chứa nội dung thật; CloudFront lưu bản cache ở edge.
items.explanationEn: origin /ˈɔːr.ə.dʒɪn/ (noun): the source server where the original content lives, such as S3 or an ALB behind CloudFront.

items.question: Trong câu "Application Load Balancer — distributes HTTP/HTTPS traffic to the application tier.", từ "distributes" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Application Load Balancer — distributes HTTP/HTTPS traffic to the application tier.", what does "distributes" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: distribute /dɪˈstrɪb.juːt/ (động từ): phân phối. "Distributes traffic" = chia lưu lượng cho nhiều instance. Danh từ: distribution.
items.explanationEn: distribute /dɪˈstrɪb.juːt/ (verb): to spread something among several places. "Distributes traffic" spreads requests across instances. Noun: distribution.

items.question: Trong câu "Auto Scaling across multiple AZs scales with load (Reliability + Cost, using Spot for the elastic portion).", từ "elastic" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Auto Scaling across multiple AZs scales with load (Reliability + Cost, using Spot for the elastic portion).", what does "elastic" (adjective) mean?
options: co giãn (tăng giảm theo nhu cầu)
optionsEn: able to grow and shrink as needed
items.explanation: elastic /ɪˈlæs.tɪk/ (tính từ): co giãn. "The elastic portion" = phần tài nguyên tăng thêm khi tải cao, có thể dùng Spot giá rẻ. Danh từ: elasticity.
items.explanationEn: elastic /ɪˈlæs.tɪk/ (adjective): able to stretch and shrink. "The elastic portion" is the extra capacity added under load, which can use cheap Spot. Noun: elasticity.

items.question: Trong câu "Auto Scaling across multiple AZs scales with load (Reliability + Cost, using Spot for the elastic portion).", từ "portion" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Auto Scaling across multiple AZs scales with load (Reliability + Cost, using Spot for the elastic portion).", what does "portion" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: portion /ˈpɔːr.ʃən/ (danh từ): phần. "The elastic portion" = phần co giãn trong tổng số instance. Đồng nghĩa: part.
items.explanationEn: portion /ˈpɔːr.ʃən/ (noun): a part of something larger. Synonym: part.

items.question: Trong câu "RDS Multi-AZ — relational database with a standby replica in another AZ and automatic failover.", từ "replica" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "RDS Multi-AZ — relational database with a standby replica in another AZ and automatic failover.", what does "replica" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: replica /ˈrep.lɪ.kə/ (danh từ): bản sao. "Standby replica" = bản sao dự phòng của database ở AZ khác. Động từ: replicate.
items.explanationEn: replica /ˈrep.lɪ.kə/ (noun): an exact copy. A "standby replica" is a backup copy of the database in another AZ. Verb: replicate.

items.question: Trong câu "ElastiCache — caches read queries to offload RDS and boost speed (Performance).", từ "boost" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "ElastiCache — caches read queries to offload RDS and boost speed (Performance).", what does "boost" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: boost /buːst/ (động từ): tăng cường. "Boost speed" = làm tốc độ nhanh hơn. Cũng là danh từ: a performance boost.
items.explanationEn: boost /buːst/ (verb): to increase or improve. "Boost speed" means make it faster. Also a noun: a performance boost.

items.question: Trong câu "S3 — stores static assets, images, and uploads using cost-saving storage classes (Cost + Sustainability).", từ "assets" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "S3 — stores static assets, images, and uploads using cost-saving storage classes (Cost + Sustainability).", what does "assets" (noun) mean?
options: tài nguyên file (ảnh, CSS, JS...) của website
optionsEn: files such as images, CSS and JS used by a website
items.explanation: asset /ˈæs.et/ (danh từ): tài nguyên tĩnh. "Static assets" = các file cố định như ảnh, CSS, JavaScript. Nghĩa kinh tế: tài sản.
items.explanationEn: asset /ˈæs.et/ (noun): files used by a website such as images, CSS and JavaScript. In finance it means something valuable you own.

items.question: Trong câu "This scenario shows how multiple services combine to achieve both HA and cost optimization.", từ "achieve" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This scenario shows how multiple services combine to achieve both HA and cost optimization.", what does "achieve" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to succeed in reaching a goal
items.explanation: achieve /əˈtʃiːv/ (động từ): đạt được. "Achieve both HA and cost optimization" = vừa đạt tính sẵn sàng cao vừa tối ưu chi phí. Danh từ: achievement.
items.explanationEn: achieve /əˈtʃiːv/ (verb): to reach a goal. "Achieve both HA and cost optimization" means get both. Noun: achievement.

items.question: Trong câu "Memorize the 6 pillars and the focus of each.", từ "focus" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Memorize the 6 pillars and the focus of each.", what does "focus" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: focus /ˈfoʊ.kəs/ (danh từ): trọng tâm. "The focus of each" = nội dung chính của từng trụ cột. Cũng là động từ: focus on (tập trung vào).
items.explanationEn: focus /ˈfoʊ.kəs/ (noun): the main thing something is about. Also a verb: focus on.

items.question: Trong câu "Map qualifier → pillar: 'cost-effective' → Cost, 'highly available' → Reliability.", từ "map" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Map qualifier → pillar: 'cost-effective' → Cost, 'highly available' → Reliability.", what does "map" (verb) mean?
options: ánh xạ, liên kết cái này với cái kia
optionsEn: to link one thing to another
items.explanation: map /mæp/ (động từ): ánh xạ. "Map qualifier → pillar" = nối từ khóa trong đề với trụ cột tương ứng. Nghĩa gốc danh từ: bản đồ.
items.explanationEn: map /mæp/ (verb): to match one thing to another. "Map qualifier → pillar" links the keyword to its pillar. As a noun it means a map.

items.question: Trong câu "Spot distractors: eliminate over-engineered answers, the wrong tool, or deprecated technology.", từ "over-engineered" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Spot distractors: eliminate over-engineered answers, the wrong tool, or deprecated technology.", what does "over-engineered" (adjective) mean?
options: thiết kế quá phức tạp so với nhu cầu
items.explanation: over-engineered /ˌoʊ.vɚ.en.dʒɪˈnɪrd/ (tính từ): thiết kế thừa. Đáp án "over-engineered" dùng quá nhiều thành phần phức tạp, tốn kém so với yêu cầu. Tiền tố "over-" = quá mức.
items.explanationEn: over-engineered /ˌoʊ.vɚ.en.dʒɪˈnɪrd/ (adjective): designed with more complexity than needed. The prefix "over-" means too much.

items.question: Trong câu "In SAA-C03, the key is to read the qualifier to identify which pillar is being asked about.", từ "identify" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In SAA-C03, the key is to read the qualifier to identify which pillar is being asked about.", what does "identify" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: identify /aɪˈden.t̬ə.faɪ/ (động từ): xác định. "Identify which pillar" = nhận ra trụ cột nào đang được hỏi. Danh từ: identification, identity.
items.explanationEn: identify /aɪˈden.t̬ə.faɪ/ (verb): to recognize and name something. "Identify which pillar" means work out which pillar is asked about. Noun: identification.

items.question: Trong câu "The Well-Architected Framework is a 6-pillar model for designing systems that are secure, reliable, high-performing, and cost-optimized.", từ "high-performing" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The Well-Architected Framework is a 6-pillar model for designing systems that are secure, reliable, high-performing, and cost-optimized.", what does "high-performing" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: high-performing /ˌhaɪ pɚˈfɔːr.mɪŋ/ (tính từ): hiệu năng cao. "High-performing systems" = hệ thống chạy nhanh, xử lý tốt. Danh từ: performance.
items.explanationEn: high-performing /ˌhaɪ pɚˈfɔːr.mɪŋ/ (adjective): performing very well. "High-performing systems" run fast and handle load well. Noun: performance.

items.question: Trong câu "Core principles: stop guessing capacity, automate, test at real scale, drive decisions with data, and run game days.", từ "automate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Core principles: stop guessing capacity, automate, test at real scale, drive decisions with data, and run game days.", what does "automate" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to make a process run by itself
items.explanation: automate /ˈɑː.t̬ə.meɪt/ (động từ): tự động hóa. "Automate" = để máy tự làm thay vì thao tác tay. Danh từ: automation.
items.explanationEn: automate /ˈɑː.t̬ə.meɪt/ (verb): to make a process work without people doing it by hand. Noun: automation.

items.question: Trong câu "Core principles: stop guessing capacity, automate, test at real scale, drive decisions with data, and run game days.", cụm từ "game days" nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Core principles: stop guessing capacity, automate, test at real scale, drive decisions with data, and run game days.", what does the phrase "game days" mean?
options: ngày diễn tập mô phỏng sự cố
items.explanation: game day /ˈɡeɪm deɪ/ (cụm từ): ngày diễn tập. "Game day" = buổi đội kỹ thuật cố ý tạo sự cố giả để luyện phản ứng và kiểm tra hệ thống.
items.explanationEn: game day /ˈɡeɪm deɪ/ (phrase): a planned practice day where a team simulates failures to test systems and responses.

items.question: Trong câu "Core principles: stop guessing capacity, automate, test at real scale, drive decisions with data, and run game days.", từ "drive" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Core principles: stop guessing capacity, automate, test at real scale, drive decisions with data, and run game days.", what does "drive" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: drive /draɪv/ (động từ): dẫn dắt. "Drive decisions with data" = để số liệu định hướng các quyết định. Tính từ liên quan: data-driven.
items.explanationEn: drive /draɪv/ (verb): to guide or push something forward. "Drive decisions with data" means let data guide decisions. Related: data-driven.
